shots.motion: A young nurse stands alone on an empty night platform in drizzle, holding an old ticket, looking toward the dark tunnel, the station sign flickers
Close-up of a young woman as a bright train headlight sweeps across her face, she looks up and swallows nervously, rain falling
An old man sitting in a night train looks up and smiles warmly as a young woman steps in through the door, the train sways
A young woman sits down slowly on a train seat and grips her bag strap, tense, looking across, the train sways
An old man chuckles and turns his head to look out of the rain-streaked train window at passing city lights
Wrinkled old hands gently pat a small round steel tiffin box on his lap, the train sways softly
A young woman laughs softly and shakes her head, eyes crinkling, city lights streak past the window behind her
An old man tells a story with gentle hand gestures while a young woman leans in and nods, the train coach rocks gently
A young woman tilts her head slightly and asks a question softly, the train sways, lights pass outside
An old man smiles faintly and slowly raises his hand to point at the seat beside the open train door, rain blows in through the door
Extreme close-up of a cracked wristwatch, the second hand ticks and stops
The fluorescent lights of an empty train coach flicker rapidly and go dark
A young woman jerks forward and half stands up from her seat in shock, staring at the empty seat opposite
Slow push in on a small steel tiffin box alone on an empty train seat, a thin wisp of steam rises and curls
Hands slowly lift the lid of a steel tiffin box revealing orange jalebis inside, faint steam rises
